description.html: HabiStat Repton in the 100 g pot has the same formula as Repton in the 40 g pouch, just in a larger, airtight pack. It is an insect dusting powder with vitamins A, D3, E, C and K3, B-group vitamins, soy protein and minerals such as iron, zinc, manganese and copper.
The ultra-fine formula sticks evenly to insects, so it is easy to apply and wastes little. The pot with a firm lid protects the powder from moisture, which matters when one pack lasts a long time.

Manufacturer's instructions: lightly dust all insects or vegetation before feeding on every 8th feed. A quarter of a teaspoon is enough. Shake the insects with the powder in a bag or tub and offer them right away. Store in a cool, dry place; for animal use only.
The 100 g pot is more practical for breeders and keepers of several geckos, dragons or chameleons. Use calcium between Repton days, and find other supplements in our equipment range.
